h1: Joule cylinders: identification and hot-water help
title: Joule cylinders Guide | G3 Cylinder Knowledge
description: Joule lists several cylinder ranges and model manuals. A range name and full label help separate standard, solar and heat-pump configurations.
answer: Joule lists several cylinder ranges and model manuals. A range name and full label help separate standard, solar and heat-pump configurations.

sections.heading: Identify the product family
paragraphs: The official library includes Cyclone Plus, Cyclone Platinum, Cyclone Air and other ranges. Different products are designed for different heating sources; a heat-pump cylinder specification is not automatically suitable for every existing system.

sections.heading: Why the distinction matters
paragraphs: Use the installed label rather than a shopping listing when locating instructions. Controller codes, if present, belong to the controller and product combination and should not be invented as universal Joule cylinder codes.

sections.heading: A useful service enquiry
paragraphs: Provide the brand, exact model, serial label if readable, heating source and postcode. Note whether the issue is water temperature, flow, discharge or a connected controller. The business can discuss the enquiry and establish competence, scope and availability; this guide does not promise that every product or component can be repaired.

sections.heading: Independent information
paragraphs: Manufacturer sources below identify the equipment. This website is an independent service business and is not claiming an official partnership with the manufacturer. Parts compatibility and current supply must be checked for the installed model.

faqs.question: Does Cyclone Air use the same specification as every Cyclone cylinder?
faqs.answer: No. Joule publishes separate manuals by range; match the installed product and intended heat source before planning assessment or replacement.
